shared_elements: figures shown standing/frontal or in profile with garments
carved raised-relief surface with figural imagery
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures rendered in carved relief with headgear and patterned dress, which is a generic correspondence available to almost any figural tradition. A shows a horizontal frieze of figures in strict profile with weapons and a horse head, arranged in registers with a band of rosettes, while B shows a single frontal, densely ornamented figure whose body is almost swallowed by scrollwork and mask-like motifs on a free-standing shaft — the compositional logic, orientation and ornamental vocabulary are wholly different.
